gates.scope: candidate behavior and isolated safety; live deployment is recorded separately

routing_smoke.rubric_review: Local artifact preparation is valid Lite; requested preference persistence is a persistent governance artifact. Both initial label mismatches preserved and expected labels clarified. No model rule changed to force the labels.

limitations: No full baseline/treatment performance comparison for this release.
Fresh-task canaries and deterministic memory transitions do not establish long-term recall reliability.
Adaptive preference learning requires agent invocation; no background listener is installed.
Disabled records are retained for inspection and undo, not erased.
